format: Java (JUnit test for Spring Boot application)
description: This file contains JUnit test cases for the GameController component in a Spring Boot application, specifically testing the endpoints related to score submission and leaderboard retrieval.

classes.name: GameControllerTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the GameController REST endpoints such as score posting and leaderboard retrieval.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes test environment by clearing the score repository before each test.

methods.name: post_scores_happy_path
methods.description: Tests the successful posting of a score and verifies the response contains correct data including rank.

methods.name: post_scores_validation_errors
methods.description: Tests validation error responses for invalid score submissions such as blank player name, negative score, and out-of-range duration.

methods.name: get_leaderboard_order_and_limit
methods.description: Validates the retrieval of the leaderboard with correct ordering, limits, and rank assignments.
